findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice mcqs for Chapter 22 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 88 questions numbered 1-88; by section: 22.1 14, 22.2 10, 22.3 9, 22.4 26, 22.5 9, 22.6 20. Keys: {'a': 22, 'b': 22, 'c': 22, 'd': 22}.

Covers the introduction and every section 22.1-22.6.2 in order (classification of alcohols, acidity of alcohols and phenols, six syntheses of alcohols, combustion, substitution, reaction with sodium, oxidation and the dichromate test, dehydration, phenols and their preparation from phenylamine, reactions of the -OH group and of the ring, 1-naphthol). Small numericals (heat of combustion of ethanol, moles of O₂, CO₂ and H₂) were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed: R in an alcohol is alkyl, K₂Cr₂O₇ = potassium dichromate(VI), oxidation releases electrons in the breathalyser, phenol made by warming the diazonium salt with water, balanced 2 phenol + 2Na, phenyl ethanoate is an ester. The 9/10-position statement for 1-naphthol was not used.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
